title: Introduce lightweight presubmit shim and dependency rotation optimizer
author: Aditi Rao
release_notes: Add a lightweight presubmit shim for lint plugins to reduce startup time; introduce a dependency rotation optimizer that schedules staged devdependency upgrades and provides telemetry; add a release-slimmer hook to trim redundant artifacts from release bundles.
description: Context: presubmit latency and noisy devdependency churn slowed developer feedback loops. Goal: introduce a lightweight presubmit shim that pulls and runs only the lint plugins relevant to changed files, add a dependency rotation optimizer that stages devdep updates to small cohorts and emits telemetry for risk scoring, and add a release-slimmer hook to reduce release artifact size. Changes include a new .github workflow, a small Go-based presubmit shim binary with a cached plugin loader, a dep-rotation scheduler script, and documentation and tests. Checklist: - Add presubmit shim and workflow; - Implement plugin cache+warm strategy; - Add dep rotation scheduler and dashboard hooks; - Add release-slimmer hook and artifact prune step; - Add unit and integration tests; - Update docs and quickstart. Motivation: presubmit startup for large monorepo caused >8s median overhead for lint setups; dependency churn caused noisy CI and frequent rollbacks. This PR reduces presubmit cold-start to ~1.2s for changed-file-only runs and lays groundwork for safer, gradual devdep upgrades. Rollout plan: staged opt-in via repo-level flag, enable for 20% of teams for 2 weeks, monitor presubmit latency and dep-rotation regressions, then full rollout. Related: ENG-4218, ENG-4321, SUP-1054.

ci_summary: Presubmit workflow initially failed on plugin download flakiness, fixed by retry/backoff; full CI passed on final run. Tests: unit 523 passed, integration 12/12 passed, flake rate reduced.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: introducing a new presubmit shim may hide plugin regressions; Mitigation: opt-in rollout and telemetry with automatic rollback on error rate >1% for two consecutive days. Dep-rotation risk: cohort selection could surface incompatible devdeps; Mitigation: small cohorts, canary tooling and automatic rollback, linear tasks ENG-4218 to enact stricter compatibility checks.
notes: This is intentionally conservative: shim does not change lint rules, only the plugin loading path. Teams that rely on global devcontainer boot will not be impacted until opt-in. The toolchain-lease integration reduces noisy global tool installs by leasing ephemeral toolchains per presubmit job.
